notes.title: Void Sols | Randomiser & Demo Update
notes.content:
🎲 RANDOMISER UPDATE! 🎲

We’re excited to introduce the Randomiser Update, a brand-new mode designed to breathe fresh chaos into your Void Sols experience! Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or just curious to mix things up, this mode offers endless replayability with unexpected twists around every corner.

Unlocking the Randomiser Update
To access this mode:
 Complete the game at least once.
 Start a new save, go to the Challenges menu, and select Randomizer.

From there, you can customize your experience with a range of settings to create a new adventure tailored to you!

Randomiser Settings
We have many settings to customize your randomiser experience:

🌱Custom Seed: If someone finds a particularly crazy seed, share it so others can give it a shot!
👾Random Enemies: Every enemy has a chance to be randomly transformed into any other enemy from the game
🗡️Random Item Placement: Flasks, Weapons, and all other equipment are randomly swapped throughout the game
🗝️Random Key Items Placement: Keys are randomly placed! We worked hard to ensure this doesn’t cause soft-locks, so be sure to check in unlikely places. There may be opportunities for sequence breaking you haven’t found!
📜Randomise Stats on Level Up: Every time you level up, your stats are randomly assigned out of the points available. Do you risk leveling up and messing with your stats?
⚔️Randomise Starting Weapon: Who knows what weapon you will start with, it could be any weapon from the entire game!
🏹Randomise Loadout on Level Up: All your loadout choices are made for you when you rest to level up. Learn to adapt to whatever RNG gives you! Combine this with random stats on level up for an extremely challenging and chaotic time.

Alongside the Randomiser update we’ve also updated the Void Sols Demo and implemented some bug fixes and other balance changes.

Patch Notes 1.5.3.6
New Features
RANDOMISER CHALLENGE
Play the game with a variety of settings randomizing your experience and creating new and surprising encounters
Permadeath Option when creating a new save
This will permanently delete your save when you die! Use with caution
Recent Items can be viewed in the pause menu to help you remember the last 10 items you picked up
Added Steam Rich Presence!Demo Update
Demo will be shortened up to the Warden
Demo progress and achievement progress can be carried across to the main game
Updated the demo to now include all 11 languages that are present in the main gameGameplay Changes
You can no longer dash through breakable walls, you must attack them to pass. Letting players dash through these walls was causing some issues with pathfinding, enemy AI, and encounter design
Made one section of the Apex Castle Town a little easier
Made one section of the Factory a little easier
Final phase of Amalgamate enemy spawn changedMinor Bug Fixes
Sols gained from killing Warden are no longer lost if you quit without resting
You can no longer find flasks in Ranger Challenge (as intended)
Fixed sorting on trapper spears, preventing them from rendering underneath the environment in some places
Ruby Phial description improved
Multiple localisation fixes in many places
Alpha Wolf should no longer be able to dash out of bounds
You should no longer see the “new” indicator if you find a potion ingredient prior to unlocking Potion Mixing
You should no longer be able to stay locked onto enemies that have died
Confessors can now have their movement speed modified (allowing them to be Trapped or slowed by Caltrops)
Fixed an animation bug with Frying Pan
Confirmation modal UI improvements
BALANCE CHANGES
Primary WeaponsScythe Heavy Attack hitbox and visual are more reliable now
Scythe Heavy Attack Stance Damage Multiplier
Original: 1
Updated: 2
Halberd Combo Attack has a bit more mobility, making it easier to land hitsRelics
Relic of Redirection no longer reduces Jolt damage from Lightning Talisman triggering Jolt on yourself. It still significantly reduces Jolt damage from enemies. We felt equipping the Relic of Redirection and Lightning Talisman offered a bit too much free damage with very little downside.Enemies
Reduced maximum number of attacks the Alpha Wolf can chain together
Slightly reduced speed of one of the Cultist Harvester’s more difficult attacks
Slightly reduced tracking of one of the Pulverizer’s attacks
Apex Grunt Poison Stacks Per Hit
Original: 50
Updated: 80
Apex Grunt Attack Damage Per Hit
Original: 60
Updated: 50Bosses
Infernal Warden
Chooses to use fire attacks at a more predictable cadence
Zenith
Phase 1 should no longer be able to dodge outside the arena
Phase 1 should attack at a more regular, predictable cadence
Phase 1 should dodge player attacks a bit more infrequently
The Randomiser Update is now available! Just update your game, dive into the unpredictable, and see how you fare in the shadows of the unknown.

Your next adventure might be the wildest one yet. 🌌✨

notes.title: Void Sols Patch 1.5.2.1 & Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

Today we're excited to announce that Void Sols is Steam Deck verified! We've also just rolled out our first major patch, 1.5.2.1. We've added quite a few new features, gameplay changes, community bug fixes, and some more weapon balance changes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/9b4b8cb409989de90de9b32d566ed18172402c1e.jpg
Full patch notes, see below:

New FeaturesApex Horn Statue does something now…
Frying Pan has a new secret synergy…
Equipping items play unique sounds!
All equipment that is picked up should now display a new item icon on the equipment button until hovered over by the player
Gameplay ChangesParrying Shield now parries whenever you release the button. Previously you could only tap to parry, meaning holding it did nothing. You can still tap to parry as before, but now you can also hold to ready the parry and release, allowing a bit more depth to parrying gameplay and not punishing the player for holding the button for a bit too long
Cold Debuff: This was previously dealing entirely too much damage to enemies. We have enough damage-dealing status effects, so we decided to rework this status effect into something that has a different kind of utility. Triggering cold on yourself has been unchanged, you still take a chunk of non-fatal damage, and have your stamina regeneration reduced. If an enemy is affected by cold however, they take stance damage, reduced move speed, and their stance will no longer regenerate until the status depletes.
The Codebearer puzzle should be a little easier now…
Zenith Phase 1 has some balance changes, and a small gameplay change that makes it a little harder
Some items moved around in Cultist Compound for better game progression
Critical Error FixesPlayer can no longer go out of bounds by going south from Zenith arena
Infernal Key can still be picked up if you died after defeating Infernal Warden
Significant fixes to the ritual used to spawn Amalgamate
Blacksmith and Alchemist no longer ask for more alloy and alembics after you have fully upgraded

No more OOBY farming
No longer counting certain easter egg items on end screen
Fixed sprite sorting of miner spin attack effect
Fixed torches that were rendering as circles instead of diamonds
Improved sprite sorting of talisman projectiles
Blue Data Disc now shows up on Apex South Map to help players find the critical progression item
Added boulder shortcut that was missing on Mountain Map A
Added analytics for when player goes out of bounds
Added minor sol shard to Apex Town so the final number of shards is divisible by 6
Fixed texture loading pop-in in Forest
Fixed texture sorting issues in Factory
Fixed texture sorting issues in Cultist Compound
Fixed camera bug in Apex Town buildings
Preventing possible Worm boss crash on death
Added safeguards to errors that sometimes happen with destructibles
Added a sol shard to the Cultist Compound to even out the sol shard count so that if you find all of them you don’t have one missing
Fixing some errors with Gatekeeper death and music
Fixed sorting issue in Shapification Chamber
Fixed an error that could occur when using controller to rename files
Adjusted Star Fish collider to be able to be caught from near the light spark
Fixed a control with a missing icon on some controllers
Confirmation modals should now close when unpausing the game if they are still open
Fixed deadzone setting slider text area not scaling correctly
Music stops properly when using  to teleport

notes.title: Void Sols Patch 1.5.1.4
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

We've just rolled out a new patch, 1.5.1.4. This patch focuses on a few community bug fixes, a new accessibility feature and some balance changes. 

Full patch notes, see below:

New FeaturesAdded a setting called “Disable Distortion Effects” that allows you to turn off the Mysterious Mushroom screen effect and other effects that can make the screen “wobbly”


Critical Error FixesNox Gamma would heal enemies that are dead, causing a variety of enemy AI errors
Talisman audio no longer persists if you are using it when you die
Chewy Seaweed, Quiver of Holding, Verdant Berry, Purifying Needle, Stale Bread now all consume a use on press instead of on release
Inserted more safeguards to prevent rare crash when pressing “Die Immediately”
Immaculate can no longer die during its phase 2 transition, causing the player to get stuck and preventing phase 2 from ever happening

Minor Bug FixesNox Alpha no longer accidentally buffs potions. The text still says it reduces potion effectiveness, but we have removed the buff without implementing the described debuff. We will update the text at a later date to remove the line about potions.
Garnet Aegis no longer accidentally buffing potion heal amount
Zenith move speed reset on stun, preventing inadvertent fast movement if stunned mid-attack
Fixing Spanish Latam metamorphic alloy / sol alembic localization error
Ensuring groundskeeper doesn’t cancel attacks when a confessor is killed
Preventing players from accidentally launching unimplemented Nox Trials due to a UI issue
Fixed enemy pathing issues in mines
The item pickup visible on the beach from the mountain disappears if you have picked up the item on the beach

Balance ChangesReduced tracking on Brute Club & Dagger attack combo
Executing Weapon Perk
Original: If health  70% increase damage by 50%
Updated: if health > 75% increase damage by 25%
Flame Talisman Player Burn Buildup
Original: 15
Updated: 20
Blizzard Talisman Player Cold Buildup
Original: 15
Updated: 20


Make sure to update your game now!

notes.title: Void Sols is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
🌌 Void Sols is OUT NOW! 🌌

[previewyoutube=9ANyHuFMNcw;full][/previewyoutube]
In Void Sols, you play as a humble Triangle, traversing a stark and unforgiving landscape. The journey isn’t just about survival but rather transformation. Battle through angular enemies, gather Sols to level up, and experiment with a variety of unique builds to shape your character into a formidable force. Hidden passageways and dark corners offer endless surprises, while the mysterious lore of Void Sols unfolds with every encounter.

🛠 Extensive Buildcrafting Options
Void Sols invites you to find the playstyle that suits you best. Experiment with a wide range of weapons, equipment, and upgrades, creating the ultimate version of your Triangle. Whether you prefer agility, power, or balance, there’s a build for every player.

⚔️ Approachable Yet Challenging Soulslike Combat
Perfect for soulslike newcomers and veterans alike, Void Sols combines challenging combat with adjustable difficulty settings. Whether you seek a true test or a lighter exploration, you control your experience.

🌌 Uncover the Lore and it’s Secrets
Explore a world filled with layered mysteries and hidden passageways, where every step reveals pieces of a lost history waiting to be uncovered. 

-

In addition to the Standard edition of Void Sols, we’ve also made available the Deluxe Edition, which includes the game, a digital artbook, Hero's Journal, and Original Soundtrack. (just a note: These are currently only available in English, however more languages will be added soon)

notes.title: Void Sols | Developer Journal vol. 3
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

We are excited to share the latest episode of our developer journal! If you missed out on our previous episodes, definitely go back and read them over here:

Episode 1 - Introduction
Episode 2 - The Forest

This time, we’re diving deep into a rugged and mysterious area that is brimming with ominous energy. Welcome to the Mountains, a place filled with towering peaks, treacherous paths, and a host of brand-new enemies just waiting to challenge even the most experienced players. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/b6c966a05179abf0c59e495260c98c47c0db19f9.jpg
As you emerge from the dense thickets of the Forest, there begins a turning point in your adventure. The world before you is now much larger, and you have the power to decide your fate. This is where your journey truly begins—the moment the world opens up, giving you the choice of which path to take next. 

Whether it was by choice or through destiny, if you’ve stumbled upon the Mountains, be prepared as this area will truly test your survival instincts against nature’s harshest elements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/01076096ea7a260d10822cb1900f365e8d2c53a7.png

When designing this mountainous region we wanted to create an area that feels grand and intimidating, where nature itself becomes a formidable foe. This challenging environment needs to be navigated carefully, as you focus your attention on how to avoid and manage certain environmental debuffs on top of every other threat that lurks around the corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/5f8c0e80d9aaddc9d233068a3edd73939bfed29f.png
Peaks of Peril
With any new region, there’s a new set of adversaries! You’ll come face to face with new angular enemies, each armed with their own distinct move sets and strapped with powerful weapons that will inevitably keep you on your toes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/032366f75c1a3fcd9742a9fc7d03f87032fb08b1.png
Stamina management will be extremely critical while traversing this region, due to the hostile conditions of the territory you’ll be faced with, in addition to the difficulty of the enemies in this area. However, there is always hope, guided by a humble Flaming Torch which you should have discovered earlier in your travels. This item will become a blessing as you navigate your way through the blistering cold.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/cd49935f360a28a6b6e633928224250da670406f.png
Harnessing Power in a Harsh Land
You might feel like the world itself is against you. Fierce enemies, dangerous terrain, and relentless weather, it can seem like every step forward is a battle for survival. However, for every brutal challenge you face, there’s also a reward waiting for you to claim it. The deeper you venture, the more powerful tools you'll discover to add to your arsenal and relics that resonate with the region, ultimately turning the tide in your favour. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/48a10ee8def79485474ea52913adc8706f6a1491.png
Crafting a World That Feels Alive
Our design team has been hard at work making sure the icy mountains are both beautiful to look at and deadly to traverse. We want this area to be a place where every corner holds a new threat, but also a reward for those who are brave enough to explore it fully. The new weapons and items aren't just powerful—they’re designed to feel like natural extensions of the environment, giving you the tools to fight the cold and conquer the unpredictable terrain.

We also wanted to give players a sense of freedom by opening up the world and allowing you to choose your path, creating a more immersive and personalised experience. We believe that every decision should feel meaningful, and each region should offer a unique set of risks with a satisfactory pay off, to make your journey unforgettable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/c58f2596752a6e9831d6e68b292302de7cb63692.png

We’re extremely excited for you to be able to explore this region fully once Void Sols launches next month, November 12th! Our demo is also available to play for free, for those of you who haven’t had a chance to dive into the world yet. 

-

Big thank you for tuning in to another chapter of this month’s Developer Journal! Are you looking forward to investigating the Mountains next month? 👀  

Remember to also wishlist Void Sols as this really helps us out, and join us over on the official Void Sols Discord server to chat with us, fellow adventurers, share tips, discuss builds and keep up to date with all news about the game. 

See you next time! 👋

notes.title: Void Sols | Developer Journal vol. 2
notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

It’s time for another Developer Journal! If you missed our last developer update, definitely go back and read it over here.

Kicking things off this time, we’re going to explore some uncharted territory. Everything we reveal today will be brand new content that not even those who have played the demo will know about. So buckle up and get ready to discover The Forest. 🌳

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/76c6d1bdd79eb8310c6b17213759864c27e1f97d.jpg
Trees tower above, their thick canopies weaving together, giving cover to the threats that lurk within. You’ve escaped the Prison, yet you’ve somehow ended up venturing deep into a lush, dense forest. The atmosphere seems serene at a glance, yet the further you go, the once peaceful surroundings now feel charged with an ominous energy. Welcome to the darkest parts of The Forest.

-

Once you successfully journey through the Prison, your next major destination is going to be the Forest. The air is thick here with the scent of pine and damp earth. Listen closely, you’ll be able to hear the soft rustling of the leaves and gentle breeze moving through the branches. As serene as this place may seem compared to where you were before, it is not the sanctuary you hope it will be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/e859f0771b7e755f0ff79049a487a3311e019ee9.png
This area is one that will connect you to even more areas of Void Sols. Hear the sound of rushing water? A river cuts through the dense woods, serving as a lifeline to help navigate your journey through the dimly lit paths. The river is narrow and the bridges are well-worn but there are new things to discover here and even more lessons to learn. 

Formidable Foes
Of course with a new area comes more unknown enemies. You’ll find yourself coming face-to-face with various new hostile shapes and forms. 

We want you to fully immerse yourself in the experience of these new opponents, so for now we’ll share some sneaky screenshots to give you a taster of what you can expect.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/8dea31750f178582537e5601b7ba783d8046f232.png
Warning: the flowers here are not your friend.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/0c4e4edabba88ff30b0cd152f376b2478b93e5ca.png
Despite these new hurdles, you’ll also have the chance to discover new items along the way. Upon leaving the Prison, you will be able to start experimenting with Usable Items: items with limited uses that always replenish when you rest. Be sure to experiment with these, you never know what might happen if you use these in the right context…  

Is it even an RPG if there is no fishing? Find the nifty little Fishing Rod and then the world truly is your oyster! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/728201194c0ad9adb1bd7949ad7dcb06d347af90.png
Level Design
Every zone in Void Sols has distinct enemies, layouts, and mechanics. We wanted players to experience a game that would constantly surprise and delight them, and to do so, we took great care to rarely repeat content. Instead of creating a massive world with the same enemies, just with more health, we opted to create a dense and diverse experience full of variety.

Each area created goes through many iterations as we design, refine, and playtest to uncover these spaces that are fun to explore and challenging to overcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/01ae4cd462912b6e8181a19463f95a62a5781d5b.png
After the game releases, see if you can figure out what area this was a WIP sketch of!

As we playtest and design spaces, we look at the empty spaces between areas and find secrets to fill them in. Many of the areas you may have previously thought to be empty will have entire zones to discover later in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/ea808fc51ef0759586f00a125993894b940c55df.png
Pay close attention to the maps you collect, they’ll show you shortcuts and secrets alike!

We can’t wait to see how you navigate the lush environments we have created and how you tackle each of the unique enemies you are bound to encounter in them.

-

That was it for this chapter of this month’s Developer Journal! We hope you enjoyed taking a peek into The Forest and a look into our level design process. In our next instalment we will be diving into even more areas that are currently in development. So definitely stay tuned! 👀

Remember to wishlist Void Sols as this really helps us out, and join the official Void Sols Discord server to chat with fellow adventurers, share tips, discuss builds and keep up to date with all news about the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736690/Void_Sols/

Until next time! 👋

--

notes.content:
Hello Triangles!

We just rolled out our first patch 1.2.5.5 for Void Sols! It should be available now for you to enjoy, just make sure to update your game. 

Full patch notes, see below:

Gameplay Updates:
Ruby Phial recharges when stunning bosses as well
Shield no longer blocks status effects
Overall improved hit registration on primary weapons
Added quick restart option on death screen after you have died at least once, allowing you to respawn outside of the checkpoint menu
Fixes:
Fixed softlock if player dies next to light spark with enough Sols to level up (as seen on PirateSoftware!)
Preventing soft locks caused by pausing after the player has died
Preventing soft locks by exiting the game while viewing the map
Fixing player deflecting thrown projectiles back at themselves
Resetting scrollbar when switching tabs in settings
Fixed broken sprite on patch notes button
Replaced mentions of "Kindling" with "Potions"
Improved contrast of keyboard icons
Fixed crafted Sols crystals being spent on only one loadout. These should give you an extra stat point across all loadouts
Fixed being able to remap lock on on keyboard
Minor improvements to lock on behaviour
Throwing dagger should not spawn on other side of small enemies if thrown right next to them
Preventing players from launching into broken states by pressing multiple buttons on the main menu
Fixed Watchers disappearing in Supermax prison 
UI:Improved UI for Switch Pro Controller
Improved readability of locked nox trials levels
Improved readability of mobility tutorial
Fixed some UI not reacting when control rebinds are reset
Fixed not being able to see light sparks on supermax prison map
Thank you again for all your support! 🔺

--

notes.title: Embark Into the Shadows: Unveiling Void Sols
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/d8ec4e524a673d434e6b30d1241db81a306082ca.jpg

Triangles,

Join us on a deep, dark journey full of mysteries. The lives of many pioneer adventurers have already been captivated by the allure of the unknown in the Prologue, and now we’re thrilled to pull back the curtain further on Void Sols, developed by Finite Reflection Studios and presented by Modern Wolf. Play the new demo now, wishlist the game, and let us know what you think by completing this survey.

Announcement Trailer
[previewyoutube=jBKZvUvNpEU;full][/previewyoutube]
Join us 
While the release date remains a mystery for now, your feedback and support are essential. Play the demo and wishlist the game below, follow our journey on X (Formerly Twitter), delve into discussions and provide your feedback in the New Discord Server, and keep informed with the Void Sols newsletter for all the latest.

More details are on the horizon. Your journey through the geometric gloom is just beginning.

About Void Sols
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950405/74d67b41dbb5e57f76459bfc25925f3f85608f38.gif

Void Sols invites you into a vast, shadow-filled maze where survival hinges on combat, strategy, and resilience. As a lone “triangle”, navigate through minimalist landscapes, engaging in tactical battles against a variety of angular enemies and bosses. Your quest is not just survival but liberation from a world dominated by darkness. Each defeat is a lesson, pushing you to refine your abilities, enhance your build with Sols, and uncover the extensive lore hidden within this abstract fantasy. Whether you're a newcomer to the soulslike genre or a seasoned veteran, Void Sols offers a range of difficulties to match your skill. Prepare to face formidable foes, and remember: in the world of Void Sols, death is just the beginning of your journey to victory.

Play the demo, wishlist the game & fill out the survey
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736690/

How far will you venture, triangles, and what secrets will you unravel?
